neighbours.label: a process running its course in a physical cycle (filling, melting, boiling off, recharging), as against a static description
fire: Once the snow thaws, the meadow floods for a few weeks.
The cartridge must be replaced every six months as it clogs up.
Leave the pot on the stove until the sauce reduces.
The cistern takes a minute to refill after each flush.
The salmon return upstream to spawn each autumn.
The daffodils flower as soon as the ground warms.
The resin has to be regenerated every few weeks.
The puddles evaporate within an hour of the rain stopping.
quiet: The meadow lies beside a narrow river at the foot of the hill.
The cartridge is a small plastic part with a blue label.
The pot on the stove belongs to my grandmother.
The cistern sits above the toilet in the upstairs bathroom.
The salmon in this river are silver with dark spots.
The daffodils near the gate are bright yellow.
The resin is a hard amber material from pine trees.
The puddles on the road are brown and shallow.
